english_text: Mr President , one of the main mechanisms for the integration of Europe is the enlargement of the European Union . Bulgaria and Romania are at the doors of the EU , Turkey is already negotiating its accession conditions , the new state of Montenegro has expressed its hope of becoming a member of the European Union , and other states in the Balkans may follow suit . In this context , I should like to focus on the issue of the Copenhagen criteria and the policies related to minorities . Many states are still following the old-fashioned French model and trying to assimilate those who have a language and culture different to that of the state .
